en.headline: Customs log 694 Hotstone Yoga reports worth about HK$7.8 million
en.dek: The figure, given for 6pm on Sunday, is up from 627 reports involving about HK$7 million logged by Saturday evening.
body: Customs said it had received 694 reports about Hotstone Yoga by 6pm on Sunday, involving about HK$7.8 million, RTHK reported. The chain, which offered prepaid yoga classes, announced it had closed all branches.

The new total is higher than the 627 reports, worth about HK$7 million, that Customs had logged by 6pm on Saturday. Complainants said they had bought prepaid classes that could not be fully delivered after the company closed.

Customs earlier arrested a 61-year-old male director on suspicion of wrongly accepting payment under the Trade Descriptions Ordinance, after reports that the centre was still selling packages before it shut. The department has said it is examining the firm's operations and finances before the closure, and has not ruled out further arrests.
The Consumer Council had separately logged several hundred complaints about the closure. Customs has asked affected customers to come forward with contract and payment records.

zh.headline: 岩盤浴瑜伽結業 海關接獲694宗舉報涉款約780萬
zh.dek: 海關回覆指，截至星期日傍晚6時共接獲694宗舉報，涉款約780萬元，高於星期六傍晚的627宗、約700萬元。
body: 提供預繳式瑜伽課程的岩盤浴瑜伽Hotstone Yoga日前宣布全線結業。港台報道，海關回覆查詢表示，截至星期日傍晚6時，共接獲694宗舉報，涉款約780萬元。
這個數字高於星期六傍晚6時的627宗、涉款約700萬元。市民向海關投訴，指購買了預繳式課程，但公司結業後未能全部兌現。
海關早前拘捕一名61歲男公司董事，涉嫌違反《商品說明條例》中不當地接受付款的罪行。署方表示正調查商戶結業前的營運及財政狀況，以及是否有不尋常銷售活動，不排除再有人被捕。
消委會亦就結業接獲數以百計投訴。海關呼籲受影響顧客提供合約及付款紀錄，以便跟進。
